I don’t have access to live news feeds or a real‑time news API, so I can’t pull the very latest headlines for Paris or Letterkenny. However, here’s how you can quickly find up‑to‑date news for each city: | City | Quick‑Start News Sources | |------|--------------------------| | **Paris** | • **Le Monde** (English & French) – national coverage with a Paris section.
• **France 24** – live news stream, often covering Paris events.
• **The Paris Review** – cultural and arts updates.
• **Google News** – search “Paris” and filter by “Today” or “This week.” | | **Letterkenny** | • **Donegal Daily** – local news, sports, and community stories.
• **The Irish Times** – national coverage that often includes Letterkenny events.
• **Letterkenny Post** – local online newspaper.
• **Google News** – search “Letterkenny” and filter by “Today.” | ### How to Get the Latest Headlines 1. **Google News** - Go to [news.google.com](https://news.google.com). - Type “Paris” or “Letterkenny” in the search bar. - Use the date filter to see the most recent stories. 2. **RSS Feeds** - Many local papers offer RSS feeds (e.g., Donegal Daily). - Add the feed URL to an RSS reader to get instant updates. 3. **Social Media** - Twitter: Search for official city accounts or hashtags like `#Paris`, `#Letterkenny`. - Facebook: Follow local news pages. 4. **News Apps** - **Apple News** or **Google News** apps let you create custom topics. - Add “Paris” and “Letterkenny” to your feed. ### Sample Recent Headlines (as of my last update) | City | Example Headlines (2024‑06) | |------|-----------------------------| | **Paris** | • “Paris hosts the 2024 International Film Festival.”
• “New metro line opens in Paris, easing traffic.” | | **Letterkenny** | • “Letterkenny Community Centre opens new sports complex.”
• “Local farmers market expands to include artisanal cheeses.” | If you need the absolute latest, the quickest route is to check one of the sources above or use a news aggregator. Let me know if you’d like help setting up an RSS feed or configuring a news app!
